title: Merge the Coins: USSR!
description: A game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues! In the game you have a game zone where coins fall and connect if they are the same! Connect as many coins as possible to get the biggest one, collect points! Become the first on the leaderboard! Play and relax!
instructions: 1 At first it will be easy to connect the coins but over time there will be more and more of them Once you connect the biggest coin in this game it will disappear and give you the most points
